description: This file provides functions for parsing, serializing, importing, and exporting interval objects from and to strings and data structures. It defines methods such as from_string, to_string, from_data, and to_data, which handle conversion between string representations and Interval objects, supporting customizable formats and infinities. It relies on external classes and constants such as Bound, inf, and Interval.

methods.name: from_string( string, conv, *, bound=r".+?", disj=r" ?| ?", sep=r", ?", left_open=r"(", left_closed=r"[", right_open=r")", right_closed=r"]", pinf=r"+inf", ninf=r"-inf", )
methods.description: Parses a string according to specified patterns and creates an Interval object with one or more intervals based on the input matrix.

methods.name: to_string( interval, conv=repr, *, disj=" | ", sep=",", left_open="(", left_closed="[", right_open=")", right_closed="]", pinf="+inf", ninf="-inf" )
methods.description: Converts an Interval object into its string representation, configurable with boundary and separator patterns.

methods.name: from_data(data, conv=None, *, pinf=float("inf"), ninf=float("-inf"))
methods.description: Creates an Interval object from a list of four-tuples specifying interval boundaries.

methods.name: to_data(interval, conv=None, *, pinf=float("inf"), ninf=float("-inf"))
methods.description: Exports an Interval object to a list of four-tuples representing interval boundaries.
